summary: Duration::checked_div truncated the seconds carry and nanoseconds contributions separately, losing a nanosecond when their remainders should combine. Dividing Duration::new(1, 1) by 7 returned 142857142 nanoseconds instead of 142857143. The fix combines both remainders before division. The commit adds the detecting regression test; its integration target requires --all-features. This plan reverses only the implementation method; no tests were executed.
expected_failure: assertion `left == right` failed: actual duration has 142857142 nanoseconds; expected 142857143 nanoseconds.
